designs.name: Claude AI Dashboard UI
designs.look: Clean, modern interface with a light background. Features a left-hand sidebar for navigation (Chat, Cowork, Code, New task, Projects, Scheduled, Live artifacts, Dispatch Beta, Customize, Pinned, Recents) and a main content area. The main area adapts based on the selected mode: a chat interface with an input field and quick action buttons ('Write', 'Strategize', 'From Drive', 'From Calendar', 'From Gmail'), a Cowork interface with 'Add files or photos', 'Skills', 'Connectors', 'Plugins' options, and a Code interface showing an activity overview (sessions, messages, tokens, streak, peak hour, active days, favorite model) and a local project selector with tabs ('Local', 'Arcads', 'main', 'worktree'). Typography is sans-serif, and interactive elements like toggles for connectors are present.

designs.name: Claude Desktop App - Co-work Section
designs.look: Clean, minimalist interface with a left-hand navigation sidebar. The sidebar features 'Chat', 'Cowork', and 'Code' tabs at the top, followed by a list of options like 'New task', 'Projects', 'Scheduled', 'Live artifacts', 'Dispatch (Beta)', and 'Customize'. Below these are 'Pinned' and 'Recents' sections for tasks. The main content area is white with a central input field for interaction. The overall vibe is professional and functional.

designs.name: Claude Desktop App - Customize Claude Section
designs.look: White background with a central illustration of a briefcase icon and the title 'Customize Claude'. Below the title, there are three distinct card-like sections with icons and descriptions: 'Connect your apps', 'Create new skills', and 'Browse plugins'. Each section has a clear title and a brief explanation. The layout is clean and easy to navigate.

designs.name: Claude Desktop App - Plugins Marketplace
designs.look: White background with a search bar at the top ('Search plugins'). Below it, categories like 'Anthropic & Partners' are displayed. The main area shows a grid of plugin cards, each with a title (e.g., 'Marketing', 'Productivity', 'Small business'), company name ('Anthropic'), download count (e.g., '1.6M', '1.1M', '679.3K'), and a brief description. Each card also has a '+' icon to add the plugin. The layout is organized and allows for easy browsing.

designs.name: Claude Desktop App - Small Business Plugin Details
designs.look: White background with a 'Back' button at the top. The title 'Small business' is prominent, followed by 'by Anthropic' and a 'View on claude.com' link. A description of the plugin is provided. Below this, there are two sections: 'Skills' and 'Connectors'. Both sections display a collection of grey, pill-shaped tags for individual skills (e.g., '/business-pulse', '/canva-creator') and connectors (e.g., 'quickbooks', 'paypal'). An 'Install' button is visible in a pop-up or overlay on the right side. The design is informative and functional.

designs.name: Notebook LM Web UI
designs.look: Clean, modern interface with a dark theme. Features a main content area displaying 'Featured notebooks' with large, visually distinct cards for each notebook. Top navigation includes 'All', 'My notebooks', 'Featured notebooks'. Minimalist design with clear typography.

designs.name: notebooklm-py GitHub Repo Page
designs.look: Standard GitHub repository layout with a dark theme. Features a README section with code blocks, badges (PyPI, Python versions, License), and links. Clear, monospace font for code. Navigation tabs for 'README', 'Contributing', 'MIT license', 'Security'.

designs.name: Claude Code Terminal Interface
designs.look: Standard command-line interface (CLI) with a dark background and light text. Displays welcome messages, tips for getting started, and command prompts. Uses a monospace font. Shows command input and output.
